name: GBrain
tagline: Moves a bot's memory into GBrain and keeps the server side running.
description: Connects a bot's long-term memory to GBrain, whether you are on their hosted service or running the server yourself. Beyond the sync it covers the operational side: queuing jobs, running consolidation passes, calibration and keeping the deployment current. Useful once a bot's memory has outgrown a plain file.
author: massimodeluisa
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
